name: Groupe Samsic (Samsic SAS, holding)
note: Family-owned French services group (Samsic Facility, Samsic RH, Samsic Airport) founded in 1986 by Christian Roulleau; the registry shows SIREN 403227796, a SAS (forme juridique 5710) registered in Rennes, chaired by Thierry Geffroy. The group's own site states it is and will remain a family-owned business; no state or fund stake found.
